ayahs.1: Qasam hai sitaare ki jab woh gire.
ayahs.2: Ke tumhare saathi ne na raah gum ki hai na woh tedhi raah par hai.
ayahs.3: Aur na woh apni khwahish se koi baat kehte hain.
ayahs.4: Woh to sirf wahi hai jo utaari jaati hai.
ayahs.5: Ise poori taaqat wale farishte ne sikhaya hai.
ayahs.6: Jo zor-aawar hai phir woh seedha khada ho gaya.
ayahs.7: Aur woh buland aasman ke kinaaron par tha.
ayahs.8: Phir nazdeek hua aur utar aaya.
ayahs.9: Pas woh do kamaanon ke ba-qadr faasla reh gaya balke is se bhi kam.
ayahs.10: Pas us ne Allah ke bande ko wahi pahunchaai jo bhi pahunchaai.
ayahs.11: Dil ne jhoot nahin kaha jise (Paighambar ne) dekha.
ayahs.12: Kya tum jhagda karte ho is par jo (Paighambar) dekhte hain.
ayahs.13: Ise to ek martaba aur bhi dekha tha.
ayahs.16: Jabke Sidra ko chhupaaye leti thi woh cheez jo is par chha rahi thi.
ayahs.17: Na to nigah behki na hadd se badhi.
ayahs.18: Yaqeenan us ne apne Rabb ki badi badi nishaniyon mein se baaz nishaniyan dekh lein.
ayahs.19: Kya tum ne Laat aur Uzza ko dekha.
ayahs.21: Kya tumhare liye ladke aur Allah ke liye ladkiyan hain?
ayahs.22: Yeh to ab badi be-insaafi ki taqseem hai.
ayahs.23: Darasal yeh sirf naam hain jo tum ne aur tumhare baap-dadon ne un ke rakh liye hain Allah ne un ki koi daleel nahin utaari. Yeh log to sirf atkal ke aur apni nafsaani khwahishon ke peechhe pade hue hain. Aur yaqeenan un ke Rabb ki taraf se un ke paas hidayat aa chuki hai.
ayahs.24: Kya har shakhs jo aarzoo kare ise mayassar hai?
ayahs.25: Allah hi ke haath hai yeh jahaan aur woh jahaan.
ayahs.26: Aur bahut se farishte aasmanon mein hain jin ki sifarish kuchh bhi nafa nahin de sakti magar yeh aur baat hai ke Allah Taala apni khushi aur apni chaahat se jis ke liye chaahe ijazat de de.
ayahs.27: Beshak jo log aakhirat par imaan nahin rakhte woh farishton ka zanana naam muqarrar karte hain.
ayahs.28: Halanke unhein is ka koi ilm nahin woh sirf apne gumaan ke peechhe pade hue hain aur beshak wahm (o gumaan) haq ke muqable mein kuchh kaam nahin deta.
ayahs.29: To aap is se munh mod len jo hamari yaad se munh mode aur jin ka irada bajuz zindagani-e-dunya ke aur kuchh na ho.
ayahs.30: Yehi un ke ilm ki intiha hai. Aap ka Rabb is se khoob waaqif hai jo us ki raah se bhatak gaya hai aur wohi khoob waaqif hai is se bhi jo raah-yafta hai.
ayahs.31: Aur Allah hi ka hai jo kuchh aasmanon mein hai aur jo kuchh zameen mein hai taake Allah Taala bure amal karne walon ko un ke aamaal ka badla de aur nek kaam karne walon ko achchha badla inayat farmaaye.
ayahs.32: Un logon ko jo bade gunaahon se bachte hain aur be-hayaai se bhi. Siwaaye kisi chhote se gunaah ke. Beshak tera Rabb bahut kushada maghfirat wala hai, woh tumhein bakhoobi jaanta hai jabke us ne tumhein zameen se paida kiya aur jabke tum apni maaon ke pet mein bachche the. Pas tum apni paakeezgi aap bayaan na karo, wohi parhezgaron ko khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.33: Kya aap ne ise dekha jis ne munh mod liya.
ayahs.34: Aur bahut kam diya aur haath rok liya.
ayahs.35: Kya ise ilm-e-ghaib hai ke woh (sab kuchh) dekh raha hai?
ayahs.36: Kya ise is cheez ki khabar nahin di gayi jo Moosa (alaihis salaam) ke.
ayahs.37: Aur wafadaar Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ke sahifon mein tha.
ayahs.38: Ke koi shakhs kisi doosre ka bojh na uthaayega.
ayahs.39: Aur yeh ke har insaan ke liye sirf wohi hai jis ki koshish khud us ne ki.
ayahs.40: Aur yeh ke beshak us ki koshish anqareeb dekhi jaayegi.
ayahs.41: Phir ise poora poora badla diya jaayega.
ayahs.42: Aur yeh ke aap ke Rabb hi ki taraf pahunchna hai.
ayahs.43: Aur yeh ke wohi hansaata hai aur wohi rulaata hai.
ayahs.44: Aur yeh ke wohi maarta hai aur jilaata hai.
ayahs.45: Aur yeh ke isi ne joda yaani nar-maada paida kiya hai.
ayahs.46: Nutfa se jabke woh tapkaaya jaata hai.
ayahs.47: Aur yeh ke isi ke zimma dobara paida karna hai.
ayahs.48: Aur yeh ke wohi maaldaar banaata hai aur sarmaaya deta hai.
ayahs.49: Aur yeh ke wohi Shiraa (sitaare) ka Rabb hai.
ayahs.50: Aur yeh ke us ne Aad-e-Oola ko halaak kiya hai.
ayahs.51: Aur Samood ko bhi (jin mein se) ek ko bhi baaqi na rakha.
ayahs.52: Aur is se pehle qaum-e-Nooh ko, yaqeenan woh bade zaalim aur sarkash the.
ayahs.53: Aur Mutafika (shehar ya ulti hui bastiyon ko) isi ne ulat diya.
ayahs.54: Phir is par chha diya jo chhaaya.
ayahs.55: Pas ae insaan tu apne Rabb ki kis kis ne'mat ke baare mein jhagdega?
ayahs.56: Yeh (Nabi) daraane wale hain pehle daraane walon mein se.
ayahs.57: Aane wali ghadi qareeb aa gayi hai.
ayahs.58: Allah ke siwa is ka (waqt-e-muayyan par khol) dikhaane wala aur koi nahin.
ayahs.59: Pas kya tum is baat se taajjub karte ho.
ayahs.60: Aur hans rahe ho? Rote nahin?
ayahs.62: Ab Allah ke saamne sajde karo aur (isi) ki ibaadat karo.
